services.name: Bag Over Shop storefront
services.description: A single-page, mobile-friendly e-commerce storefront with a product cart and WhatsApp checkout.

questions.question: Which language should the Bag Over Shop storefront use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a maintainable storefront with typed product and cart data.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: A lightweight choice if you prefer plain JavaScript.

questions.rationale: A TypeScript frontend is a good default for a small, maintainable single-page shop.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?

options.label: React
options.description: Recommended for a responsive single-page storefront with reusable product and cart components.

options.label: Vue
options.description: A lightweight component framework for interactive storefronts.

questions.rationale: React is a practical default for the requested single-page cart experience.

questions.question: Confirm or add the storefront features and behavior.
questions.recommendedChoice: Single-page storefront; browse product cards with real photos and KES prices; add/remove/update cart items; prepare an order summary and open WhatsApp checkout. Include your full section/design specification and any products or styling requirements.
questions.answer: Create a responsive, single-page premium minimalist bag shop with smooth-scroll navigation and a sticky transparent-to-solid navbar, cart icon/counter, warm cream/charcoal/tan palette, serif headings, sans-serif body, generous whitespace, subtle hover/fade-in effects. Sections in order: full-screen lifestyle-photo hero with headline/tagline/Shop Now; six category cards (Handbags, Backpacks, Tote Bags, Crossbody, Travel Bags, Laptop Bags); 8-12 featured/new-arrival products with category/price filters, price sorting, KES prices, add-to-cart and wishlist; product quick-view with image, description, colors and quantity; benefits; star-rated testimonial slider; Instagram-style photo strip; newsletter signup; online contact/order form with WhatsApp and location; footer with social links, M-Pesa/card payment methods, copyright. Functional slide-out cart supports remove, quantity changes and live total; checkout opens WhatsApp with order summary; back-to-top button. Use real free-to-use bag photography only (Unsplash/Pexels), consistent square/4:5 crop, lazy loading, alt text, and central editable image/product data. Use browser-only interactions without requiring customer accounts or a backend.
questions.rationale: The full detailed design and functional brief was provided in the initial user message.

questions.question: Which data stores should the project use? The storefront needs photo assets for product imagery. Select every required store; choose “No datastore required” only if no Azure-backed storage is needed.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use only in-browser cart state and externally hosted or bundled static data; no Azure storage resource.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store and serve real product photos and other static media.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Persist product catalog, inventory, customer, or order records.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Persist relational product, inventory, customer, or order records.

questions.rationale: This is a static, browser-only storefront with WhatsApp order handoff. Product photos can be hosted on the requested free image source; no persistent catalog or order database was requested.

questions.question: Should customers sign in to use Bag Over Shop features?

options.label: No
options.description: Allow customers to browse, build a cart, and continue to WhatsApp without an account.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require customer sign-in for application features.

questions.rationale: A cart handed off to WhatsApp can work without customer accounts.

questions.question: What WhatsApp business number should checkout open, including country code, and what order details should the prefilled message include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Provide the business WhatsApp number with country code (for example, Kenya +254) and any preferred message wording. If not yet available, say so.
questions.answer: Use the Kenyan number 0741363694 in international WhatsApp link format +254741363694. Prefill an order summary with item names, quantities, prices, cart total, and contact form details when relevant.
questions.rationale: The user supplied the WhatsApp contact number; Kenya country code is used for WhatsApp checkout.
